notes: «ابنا أبي شيبة», the descriptor of Uthman and Abu Bakr, is left out of the surfaces
«قال ابن الصباح في حديثه محرمة» is a wording remark: no link
the Companion Aisha is the last link: «قال سألت عائشة» with her answer as the saying (rule 5)

fixes.reason: The text makes the first link Uthman a son of Abi Shayba, but the lexicon attaches Uthman b. Affan to the same id.

evidence.quote: عثمان، وأبو بكر ابنا أبي شيبة
